newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares open firmer, block deals dominate.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares open firmer, block deals dominate.

text.p: Singapore shares opened firmer on Tuesday, buoyed by Wall Street's gains overnight.
"Wall Street closed strongly for two sessions in a row, so that has lifted sentiment somewhat. It looks like it is going to be a positive day," said a dealer with local brokerage.
After about half an hour of trading, the Straits Times Industrials index was up 12.44 points to 2,110.89. Volume was 18.2 million shares with 95 gainers against 11 losers.
Dealers said the early action saw several block trades married, with furnishings group Roly International heading the actives list after eight million shares were crossed at US$0.675.
Property-based United Industrial Corp also saw 841,000 shares married at Singapore $1.27.
Dealers said there was some light buying of shipyards with Keppel Corp, Sembawang and Jurong Shipyard firming 10 to 20 Singapore cents each.
"All the bad news is already out on shipyards, so it is being sold as a recovery play," said a dealer.
